message.content: Read /Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/InkOS/app/(app)/clients/ClientsPageClient.tsx lines 500-650. I need to see the empty-state rendering logic — specifically how `dbEmpty` is used to branch between "Add your first client" vs "No clients match these filters". Report the exact conditional logic and what each branch renders. Under 150 words.

content.text:
Here is the exact conditional logic from lines 560-650:

`dbEmpty` is derived as `totalActiveClients === 0` (line 576). The branching is:

1. `if (filters.showArchived)` — regardless of `dbEmpty`, renders EmptyState with title "No archived clients" and a "Back to active clients" CTA. `variant="no-results"`.

2. `if (dbEmpty && !hasActiveFilters && !searchActive)` — all three conditions must be true (zero total active clients, no filters applied, no search query). Renders EmptyState with title "Add your first client", two CTAs: "+ Add your first client" (triggers `handleNewClient`) and "Import from CSV". `variant="first-time"`.

3. Fallthrough (clients exist but query returned zero) — renders EmptyState with title "No clients match these filters". If a saved view is active (`activeView` truthy), description names the view and adds a secondary "Edit view filters" CTA. Otherwise, uses `SearchX` icon with generic description. Both include a "Clear filters" primary CTA that resets to `DEFAULT_FILTERS`. `variant="no-results"`.
